item.title: Panel Session on Economics of Innovation: Opening remarks | Conference "Trust and Innovation – The Future of Finance"

rating.summary: Bundesbank President Joachim Nagel delivered opening remarks at a conference on the future of finance, focusing on Europe's innovation challenges. He identified three levers to stimulate innovation and growth: deepening the Single Market, improving access to funding through a savings and investments union, and strengthening infrastructure including energy grids, digital infrastructure, and education. The speech contained no discussion of monetary policy, interest rates, or the inflation outlook.
rating.stance_rationale: This speech is not about monetary policy; it addresses structural economic issues such as innovation, capital markets, and infrastructure investment in Europe. No monetary policy stance can be inferred.
key_quotes: Europe is struggling to help innovative firms scale up and grow into globally competitive companies.
Europe's innovation challenge is not a shortage of ideas. It is above all a challenge of scaling, financing and providing common European infrastructure.
